ExploreFact.Text: I found a large artificial station near above the solar system.
The station was relocated here after something in this solar system disrupted a device called the Predictor.
The Ephemeris was badly damaged during its sudden relocation, although most of its critical systems still function.
Temporal zones aboard the Ephemeris remain suspended while empty. Entering a zone resumes local time, and leaving it vacant causes it to reset.

RumorFact.Text: Several sections of the Ephemeris contain strange artificial environments.

ExploreFact.Text: The environments aboard the station were modeled after possible habitable worlds predicted by the Vyss.
Every environment tested by the Caretaker eventually became unsuitable for life.

RumorFact.Text: One section of the arboretum contains an artificial basalt environment.

ExploreFact.Text: One of the artificial environments is a basalt dunes with rising and falling lava.

RumorFact.Text: One section of the arboretum contains an artificial cave environment.

ExploreFact.Text: One of the artificial environments is a flooded cave system.

RumorFact.Text: One section of the arboretum contains an artificial spike environment.

ExploreFact.Text: One of the artificial environments is a maze of tall, sharp rock formations.

RumorFact.Text: One section of the arboretum contains an artificial beach environment.

ExploreFact.Text: One of the artificial environments is a beach with a continuously changing tide.
The tide resets when I leave the beach.
Leaving my scout at the beach allows the tide to keep moving after I leave.

RumorFact.Text: There is a hidden windowed hatch in the center of Hexagon Beach.

ExploreFact.Text: The hatch overlooks a staircase below, but I can't fit through it.
My scout is small enough to fit through the hatch.
The hatch can be opened from below. Once opened, it stays open and provides a direct route between the beach and the staircase beneath it.

RumorFact.Text: A lower maintenance passage provides emergency access to the Caretaker's chamber.
The maintenance passage beneath the beach reaches the Caretaker only at high tide, but the beach must somehow remain active after I leave.
The staircase beneath the windowed hatch continues into a lower section of the station.

ExploreFact.Text: I found a hidden maintenance passage containing a strange device and a staircase up to the beach.
The device in the maintenance passage is a teleporter leading to the Caretaker's chamber.

RumorFact.Text: A lower maintenance passage provides emergency access to the Caretaker's chamber.

ExploreFact.Text: I warped to a spherical chamber containing an enormous snake-like machine surrounded by water lilies.

RumorFact.Text: The Caretaker's records mention a device called the Predictor that stopped responding.

ExploreFact.Text: The Predictor was built by the Vyss to examine possible futures and determine how distant worlds would change over time.
The Predictor encountered an enormous number of branching futures originating somewhere in this solar system and failed while trying to process them.
The Ash Twin Project's repeated time loops may be responsible for the impossible number of futures that overwhelmed the Predictor.

RumorFact.Text: Records aboard the Ephemeris repeatedly refer to someone called the Caretaker.
An enormous snake-like machine occupies the chamber reached through a teleporter in the maintenance passage.

ExploreFact.Text: I found the Caretaker, a large machine built by the Vyss to maintain and pilot the Ephemeris while they sleep.
The Caretaker cannot leave its chamber, but it can remotely control most of the station.
I found a device that somehow predicted both my language and the translator I would be carrying, then used that information to add the Vyss language to it.

RumorFact.Text: The translation device that predicted my translator identified the station's language as belonging to a species called the Vyss.
The Caretaker was built by a species called the Vyss, who are still somewhere aboard the station.

ExploreFact.Text: The Vyss learned that the universe would eventually end and chose to sleep while the Caretaker searched for a safe future in which to wake them.
The Caretaker never found a permanent refuge. Every possible environment eventually failed.
The Caretaker realized that waiting forever for somewhere safe would only deprive the Vyss of what little time remained.
